verdict.rationale: First-party docs include a dedicated function/tool-calling guide and a tools guide covering custom functions, Programmatic Tool Calling, tool search and remote MCP. The Agents guide and Agents SDK document multi-step agent loops that keep context across steps, and Structured Outputs enforces adherence to a supplied JSON Schema. missing for 10: explicit evidence of parallel tool calls, explicit documentation that tool definitions are typed via JSON Schema, independent or hands-on corroboration that tool calling is faithful in agent loops.
